title: Why Excel Power Query Won't Auto-Refresh (3 Fixes That Work)
description: Your Power Automate flow says SUCCESS, but the Excel Power Query report is still stale? This guide explains why Office Scripts triggered by Power Automate cloud flows cannot refresh most non-Power BI sources, then compares Excel Desktop refresh-on-open, supported Power BI/dataflow scheduled refresh, and upstream data ingestion. Includes a Power Query From Folder walkthrough and 3 verification checks. Sales amounts are fictional illustrative examples. #Excel #PowerQuery #PowerAutomate #Automation

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.narration: A green Power Automate flow can leave a stale Excel report.

scenes.title: Stale workbook proof
scenes.narration: Sixteen new source rows but twelve old rows in report.

scenes.title: Technical limitation
scenes.narration: Microsoft's documentation says most refresh calls do not work inside cloud-run Office Scripts.

scenes.title: Refresh on open
scenes.narration: Use Excel Desktop connection properties when a person opens the workbook.

scenes.title: Cloud solution
scenes.narration: Use a data platform with supported scheduled refresh and correct access.

scenes.title: Direct ingestion
scenes.narration: Move source records through supported connectors rather than triggering unsupported refresh.

scenes.title: Power Query From Folder
scenes.narration: Combine matching CSV files and refresh the query when needed.

scenes.title: Three verification checks
scenes.narration: Verify source, actual refresh execution and output row counts.

scenes.title: Conclusion
scenes.narration: Choose appropriate engine and independently confirm data freshness.
